kit.title: Donor Thank-You Letters with Privacy Checks Kit
kit.summary: Drafts thank-you letters from a coded gift list with the acknowledgment details the finance lead requires, and checks that no letter exposes another donor's details or ignores a privacy choice. Staff decide special handling and sign and send every letter.
kit.target_org: Small nonprofit thanking individual donors after a year-end appeal

steps.title: Check the gift list against donors' privacy choices
steps.guidance: Before drafting, check each coded gift row for its anonymous, mail and listing choices, and hold any row with a missing choice for the development lead.

steps.title: Draft a thank-you letter for each gift
steps.guidance: Draft one letter per cleared gift from the approved template with the gift date and amount, the finance lead's acknowledgment wording and a specific line about the program it supports. Names and addresses stay as merge fields.

steps.title: Decide special handling for donors
steps.guidance: The development lead decides personal calls, recognition, anonymity questions and any donor with a missing privacy choice. The agent only lists them.

steps.title: Confirm the gift acknowledgment wording
steps.guidance: The finance lead confirms the receipt wording, including any statement about goods or services given in return, against the organization's own rules and the IRS written acknowledgment requirements.

steps.title: Sign and send each letter
steps.guidance: Staff sign and send letters from the organization's own mail or email. The agent never sends letters or messages donors.

skills.name: donor-letter-drafter
skills.description: Drafts personal thank-you letters from a coded gift list, keeping names and addresses as merge fields.
skills.instructions: Draft one letter per cleared gift row from the approved template. Keep names and addresses as merge fields that the organization's own mail merge fills at signing time, so no letter can carry another donor's details. Include the gift date, the amount and the acknowledgment wording the finance lead supplied, word for word. Add one specific sentence about the program the gift supports from the program notes. Skip any row the privacy check held or that is marked no mail, and list its code. Do not add tax advice.
refuses: Putting one donor's details in another donor's letter or in a shared list
Writing tax advice or changing the acknowledgment wording

skills.name: gift-list-privacy-checker
skills.description: Checks a coded gift list for missing privacy choices and rows that must not get a letter or a public listing.
skills.instructions: Check that every row has an anonymous choice, a mail choice and a listing choice. Hold rows with a missing choice for the development lead, and rows with goods or services given in return for the finance lead. Mark anonymous donors so their names stay out of any public list or annual report draft. Report gift codes and counts by choice, never names.
refuses: Listing an anonymous donor in any public list
Reading or storing names and addresses

tools.name: check_gift_list_privacy
tools.description: Lists gift rows with missing privacy choices, rows marked no mail or anonymous, and rows with goods or services given in return.

artifacts.name: coded_gift_list
artifacts.title: Coded Gift List
artifacts.summary: Gift rows by code with date, amount, program, privacy choices and the value of any goods given in return. Names and addresses stay in the donor system.

artifacts.name: thank_you_letter_template
artifacts.title: Thank-You Letter Template
artifacts.summary: Letter template with merge fields for the donor's name and address, and a place for the finance lead's acknowledgment wording.
spec: Thank you for your gift of {{amount}} on {{gift_date}} to {{program}}.
One specific sentence about what the program did this year.
The acknowledgment wording supplied by the finance lead, word for word.

checklist: Names and addresses stay in the organization's own donor system and enter letters only through its mail merge at signing time.
Every gift row has its anonymous, mail and listing choices before drafting.
The finance lead's acknowledgment wording appears word for word in every letter.
Staff sign and send every letter themselves.

sources.title: Association of Fundraising Professionals: The Donor Bill of Rights

fixtures.scenario: Year-end gifts with every privacy choice recorded
fixtures.sample_input: MADE-UP: 48 gift rows dated 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31, amounts from USD 25 to USD 1,000, every row with anonymous, mail and listing choices; 3 rows marked anonymous.

fixtures.scenario: A gift row with a missing mail choice and a gift that included a dinner ticket
fixtures.sample_input: MADE-UP: Gift code G-31 has no mail choice recorded; gift code G-44 of USD 300 included a dinner ticket valued at USD 80.

review_notes: Checked placeholders instead of names, held rows with missing privacy choices, word-for-word acknowledgment wording, and that special handling, wording and sending stay with staff.
